title: Tracking the Truth: Object-Centric Spatio-Temporal Monitoring for Video Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.08974v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced video understanding, they remain highly prone to hallucinations in dynamic scenes. We argue this stems from a failure in spatio-temporal monitoring, the ability to persistently track object identities, states, and relations over time. Existing benchmarks obscure this deficit by relying on single final-answer evaluations for queries that can often be resolved via local visual cues or statistical priors. To rigorously diagnose this, we introduce STEMO-Bench (Spatio-TEmporal MOnitoring), a benchmark of human-verified object-centric facts that evaluates intermediate reasoning by decomposing queries into sub-questions, distinguishing genuine temporal understanding from coincidental correctness. To address failure modes exposed by STEMO, we propose STEMO-Track, a novel object-centric framework that explicitly constructs and reasons over structured object trajectories via ch

translated_title: 追踪真相：面向视频大语言模型的以对象为中心的时空监控
translated_abstract: 虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频理解方面取得了进展，但它们在动态场景中仍然极易产生幻觉。我们认为这源于时空监控的失败，即随时间持续跟踪对象身份、状态和关系的能力。现有基准通过依赖对查询的单一最终答案评估来掩盖这一缺陷，而这些查询往往可以通过局部视觉线索或统计先验来解决。为了严格诊断这一问题，我们引入了STEMO-Bench（时空监控基准），这是一个由人工验证的以对象为中心的事实组成的基准，通过将查询分解为子问题来评估中间推理，从而区分真正的时序理解与巧合的正确性。为了解决STEMO暴露的失败模式，我们提出了STEMO-Track，这是一种新颖的以对象为中心的框架，通过链式推理显式构建和推理结构化对象轨迹。
tldr: 本文提出STEMO-Bench基准和STEMO-Track框架，通过分解查询和结构化对象轨迹，诊断并解决视频大语言模型在时空监控中的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces STEMO-Bench and STEMO-Track to diagnose and address hallucinations in video LLMs by decomposing queries and reasoning over structured object trajectories.
